Container.Name: dispatch-cpu-runner
Container.Overview: Pull-based CPU job runner. It polls a job-queue API on your LAN, runs each job (verify/test/mutation commands) in an empty network namespace as an unprivileged user, and posts the result back. First start: paste the queue API URL and a single-use enrollment code; the container fetches and stores its own token. Fixed LAN identity via br0 (IP in the Network field, MAC in Extra Parameters). Disk use: at most 2 lane jobs (setup / LLM) at once, none claimed while free space is under 6 GB, and the uv / npm / node_modules caches in /cache are capped (about 20 GB worst case, rebuilt on demand: leave /cache out of appdata backups). Job scratch space (/work) is Docker storage and is not mapped here; a full docker.img hurts every container on the server. Update the queue API before the runner. See the README, section Disk use.

Config.Name: Queue API URL
Config.Description: LAN URL of the job-queue API, printed by `cpu_lane.py enroll-code` on the queue host. Use the host's LAN IP, not a public hostname.

Config.Name: Enrollment code (first start)
Config.Description: Single-use code (valid 1 hour) from `cpu_lane.py enroll-code`. Only needed once, or after a token rotation; the token is stored in the state path below. May be left empty afterwards.

Config.Name: Token (fallback)
Config.Description: Optional: paste the shared token directly instead of enrolling. Leave empty normally.

Config.Name: Runner ID
Config.Description: Name shown on the queue dashboard.

Config.Name: Isolation
Config.Description: required (fail closed, default), auto, or none. Leave on required.

Config.Name: Concurrency (override)
Config.Description: Leave empty to use the value configured on the queue (cpu_lane.py config concurrency=N). Setting it here overrides.

Config.Name: Lane jobs at once
Config.Description: Most lane jobs (jobs with a setup phase or LLM calls) running at once; plain jobs are not counted. Leave empty to use the queue's value (cpu_lane.py config lane_max=N), else 2. 0 turns lane jobs off on this runner.

Config.Name: Min free space GB
Config.Description: Free space (GB) /work and /cache must each have before a lane job is claimed. Below 2 GB (or this value, if lower) no job is claimed at all. Waiting jobs show the reason in the queue. Leave empty to use the queue's value, else 6.

Config.Name: uv cache cap GB
Config.Description: Cap for the uv cache in /cache. Over it, the cache is cleared whole once no job is running (claims pause meanwhile). Leave empty to use the queue's value, else 10.

Config.Name: npm cache cap GB
Config.Description: Cap for the npm cache in /cache. Over it, the cache is cleared whole once no job is running (claims pause meanwhile). Leave empty to use the queue's value, else 4.

Config.Name: node_modules cache cap GB
Config.Description: Cap for the node_modules copies in /cache: the oldest are evicted after installs (the entry limit is CPU_RUNNER_CACHE_MAX, 8). Leave empty to use the queue's value, else 6.

Config.Name: Disk check interval (s)
Config.Description: Seconds between the disk thread's measurements and cache cleanups (at least 5). Leave empty for 120. Not pulled from the queue.

Config.Name: Accept (all or lane)
Config.Description: Leave empty for all. Set lane to make this a lane-only runner: it takes only lane jobs (a setup phase or LLM calls) and leaves the plain jobs to your main runner. Use it on a second runner, with its own Runner ID. Needs a queue that knows accept lane (an older queue hands it plain jobs and it gives each back, costing that job an attempt). Any other value stops the runner at start. Not pulled from the queue.

Config.Name: State (stored token)
Config.Description: Holds the enrolled token (0600). Keep private.

Config.Name: Dependency cache
Config.Description: Persistent npm, node_modules and uv caches, capped (about 20 GB worst case) and rebuilt on demand: exclude this path from appdata backups. Sits on the cache pool with the rest of appdata.
